message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red and brownish-orange background. Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO" with "50 Tahun!" written below in a white script. Smaller black text at the very top includes "CALON KAPOLRI DARI GENG SOLO" and "DI BALIK JATUHNYA SRIWIJAYA AIR."

The central image depicts a series of figures on grey and white horizontal bands resembling steps. At the top left, a person wearing a white face shield and dark vest administers an injection into the arm of a kneeling person. Below them, a line of five people in grey shirts and dark trousers, all wearing white face masks, face away from the viewer. A man in a dark shirt and brown pants runs toward the right. On the lower right, a figure in a dark vest and helmet, wearing a face shield, points a finger while holding a dark baton overhead.

Large black text on the right reads "BERTARUH PADA VAKSIN." Below this, smaller text states, "Distribusi vaksin sempat tersendat di sejumlah provinsi. Angka efikasi Sinovac bisa berubah karena sampelnya baru 30 persen." Small text at the bottom right includes a barcode, QR code, and "18-24 JANUARI 2021 RP 45.000."
